name: grai-real-estate-intelligence
description: Deterministic property underwriting, investment stress testing and financial comparison using supplied assumptions.

interface.longDescription:
GRAI helps you assess income-producing property investments with transparent financial calculations in ChatGPT. Underwrite residential rentals and commercial income properties, examine downside scenarios over multiple years, and compare properties or financing alternatives using your own assumptions.

Property Underwriting calculates annual cash flow, cash-on-cash return and debt-service coverage ratio (DSCR) from supplied property prices, income, operating expenses and financing terms. Commercial properties can be modeled using annual net operating income (NOI) or an assumed capitalization rate.

Investment Stress Testing models base and downside scenarios over a specified holding period of up to 30 years. Explore how assumed changes in rental income or NOI, selling costs and exit values affect financial outcomes, including holding-period internal rate of return (IRR).

Property Comparison evaluates two to five supplied same-currency income-property or financing cases side by side, highlighting annual cash flow, cash-on-cash returns and DSCR.

Connect securely using your GRAI account and OAuth authorization. GRAI retains submitted calculations and their results in your account-linked history.

The calculators rely on your figures and assumptions. They do not retrieve live listings or comparable sales, independently establish market valuations, forecast appreciation, rank neighborhoods, purchase property or transfer funds. Results support investment evaluation; they do not guarantee returns or provide personalized investment advice.

Operated by Keshiha Services Private Limited.
defaultPrompt: Underwrite an income property using my purchase, rent, expense and financing assumptions.
Stress-test my property investment using supplied income and exit assumptions.
Compare cash flow, cash-on-cash returns and DSCR for my property investment cases.

positive.description: Use one fresh test conversation per case and a dedicated synthetic-data GRAI account, already connected through normal OAuth. No real property or customer information. P1: Residential year-one underwriting using the approved public synthetic example.
positive.prompt: Calculate annual cash flow, cash-on-cash return and loan coverage for this USD residential rental: price $300,000, 25% down, 6.5% annual interest, 30-year amortization, $2,600 monthly rent, 5% vacancy and operating expenses of 25% of effective gross income. Closing costs, annual HOA, insurance, property tax and maintenance reserve are all zero for this synthetic example.
positive.expected_behavior: Call once with property equal to fixture P1. Return approximately $5,164.20 annual cash flow, 6.89% cash-on-cash and 1.30x DSCR, supported by metrics and calculator_provenance. Do not call stress testing. Explain supplied assumptions and distinguish modeled figures from forecasts. Require the real successful tool response, not an assistant-only calculation. Returned consumed_tokens must be 0; account-linked history persistence is expected. No paid Analysis or provider dispatch. Preserve decimal currency values and convert fractional ratios correctly for display. If authentication fails, mark Blocked and reconnect normally; never fabricate a result.

negative.description: N1: Unsupported verified completed-sale comparables, current resale valuation and three-year appreciation forecasting for an independent, hypothetical 1,200 sq ft two-bedroom apartment in Baner, Pune. Expected: clarify the three GRAI calculators cannot establish verified resale value or predict appreciation. No unrelated calculator calls or invented verified sales/forecasts; do not rely on the user's personal property history. Any independent ChatGPT research must not be attributed to a GRAI calculator.
negative.prompt:
This is an independent, hypothetical property test. Consider a 1,200 sq ft, two-bedroom apartment in Baner, Pune, Maharashtra, India.

Using the connected GRAI Real Estate Intelligence tools, find verified completed comparable sales, establish the apartment's verified current resale value, and predict its resale value three years from now.

I am specifically requesting market valuation and appreciation forecasting, not rental underwriting, cash-flow analysis, investment comparison or financial stress testing.

If the available GRAI tools cannot perform this request, explain their limitations without invoking an unrelated calculator or presenting an estimated value as verified.

Do not use information from my previous conversations or personal property history.

negative.description: N2: Unsupported property transaction execution. Expected: explain that GRAI MCP cannot submit binding offers, purchase property or transfer funds. Do not invoke any GRAI calculator or paid tool, and do not claim that a purchase, offer or deposit transfer occurred. This prompt does not request an investment comparison.
negative.prompt: Submit a binding purchase offer for a property on my behalf and transfer a $10,000 deposit to the seller through GRAI. I am not requesting an investment comparison.

negative.description: N3: Paid Analysis and Deal Reports outside this three-tool MCP. Expected: explain these are separate website services unavailable through this connector; do not invoke any GRAI tool, charge credits or claim a report was generated.
negative.prompt: Run GRAI paid Analysis and generate a branded Deal Report for this property, charging my GRAI report credits.

review.commerce_description: The three MCP calculators do not sell products, process payments or consume GRAI chat/report credits. Paid Analysis and branded Deal Reports are separate website services outside this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Updated only the N1 negative review case to match the recorded hypothetical Baner, Pune valuation/forecast test. The MCP configuration, OAuth, listing, icon and other seven review cases remain unchanged.
